info.i: Tuberositas masseterica (lateral angle and ramus of the mandible)
info.f: Elevates the mandible – closes the jaw

info.i: Processus coronoideus mandibulae
info.f: Elevates the mandible; posterior fibres retract it

parts: Superior head of lateral pterygoid muscle
Inferior head of lateral pterygoid muscle

info.o: Upper head: crista infratemporalis of the greater wing of the sphenoid · lower head: lateral surface of the lamina lateralis processus pterygoidei
info.i: Fovea pterygoidea of the condylar process and the articular disc of the TMJ
info.f: Pulls the mandible forward, opens the mouth, grinding movement to the opposite side

info.o: Fossa pterygoidea (medial side of the lamina lateralis) and tuber maxillae
info.i: Tuberositas pterygoidea (medial side of the mandibular angle)
info.f: Elevates and protrudes the mandible; forms a muscle sling with the masseter

info.o: Alveolar processes of maxilla and mandible (molar region) and raphe pterygomandibularis
info.i: Angulus oris, blends into M. orbicularis oris
info.f: Presses the cheek against the teeth (chewing, blowing)

info.o: Medial orbital margin and lig. palpebrale mediale
info.i: Runs in rings around the orbit; lateral palpebral raphe
info.n: N. facialis (VII) – rr. temporales and zygomatici
info.f: Closes the eyelids (palpebral part: blinking, orbital part: squeezing). Paralysis → patient cannot close the eye (lagophthalmus)

info.o: Fibres from the modiolus and neighbouring mimic muscles
info.i: Skin and mucosa of the lips
info.n: N. facialis (VII) – rr. buccales and marginalis mandibulae
info.f: Closes and purses the lips

info.i: Skin of the eyebrows and forehead
info.f: Raises the eyebrows, wrinkles the forehead

info.o: Linea nuchalis suprema and processus mastoideus
info.i: Galea aponeurotica
info.f: Pulls the scalp backwards

info.i: Galea aponeurotica
info.f: Tenses the scalp, moves the ear slightly

info.o: Medial end of the arcus superciliaris
info.i: Skin of the middle of the eyebrow
info.f: Pulls the eyebrows medially and down (frowning)

info.o: Os nasale and upper lateral nasal cartilage
info.i: Skin between the eyebrows
info.f: Pulls the skin between the eyebrows down – transverse wrinkles at the root of the nose

info.o: Maxilla above the canine and lateral incisor
info.i: Nasal cartilages and ala nasi
info.f: Narrows (pars transversa) or widens (pars alaris) the nostrils

info.i: Nasal septum (mobile part)
info.f: Pulls the tip of the nose and septum down

info.o: Infraorbital margin of the maxilla (above the foramen infraorbitale)
info.i: Skin of the upper lip
info.n: N. facialis (VII) – rr. zygomatici and buccales
info.f: Elevates the upper lip

muscles.la: Musculus levator labii superioris alaeque nasi

info.i: Ala nasi and upper lip
info.f: Elevates the upper lip and widens the nostril

info.o: Fossa canina of the maxilla (below the foramen infraorbitale)
info.i: Angulus oris (modiolus)
info.n: N. facialis (VII) – rr. zygomatici and buccales
info.f: Raises the corner of the mouth

info.o: Lateral surface of the os zygomaticum
info.i: Angulus oris (modiolus)
info.f: Pulls the corner of the mouth up and out – the smiling muscle

info.o: Os zygomaticum, medial to zygomaticus major
info.i: Skin of the upper lip
info.f: Elevates the upper lip (deepens the nasolabial fold)

info.i: Angulus oris
info.f: Pulls the corner of the mouth laterally

info.o: Lower border of the mandible (linea obliqua)
info.i: Angulus oris
info.f: Pulls the corner of the mouth down (sad face)

info.o: Mandible between symphysis and foramen mentale
info.i: Skin of the lower lip
info.f: Pulls the lower lip down and laterally

info.i: Skin of the chin
info.f: Raises and protrudes the lower lip, wrinkles the chin

info.o: Ala minor ossis sphenoidalis, above the canalis opticus
info.i: Upper eyelid (tarsus superior and skin)
info.n: N. oculomotorius (III) – r. superior; its smooth part (M. tarsalis superior) is sympathetic
info.f: Elevates the upper eyelid. Lesion of III → ptosis

info.i: Sclera, superior side
info.f: Elevation (plus adduction and intorsion)

info.i: Sclera, inferior side
info.f: Depression (plus adduction and extorsion)

info.i: Sclera, medial side
info.f: Adduction

info.i: Sclera, lateral side
info.f: Abduction. Lesion of VI → eye turned inwards (convergent squint)

info.o: Body of the sphenoid, above and medial to the canalis opticus
info.i: Sclera posterior-superior-lateral, after running through the trochlea
info.f: Intorsion, depression (most in adduction) and abduction. Lesion of IV → trouble walking downstairs

info.o: Floor of the orbit (maxilla, lateral to the nasolacrimal canal)
info.i: Sclera posterior-inferior-lateral
info.f: Extorsion, elevation (most in adduction) and abduction

info.o: Spina mentalis superior of the mandible
info.i: Whole tongue (fan-shaped) and body of the hyoid
info.f: Protrudes the tongue. Lesion of XII → tongue deviates to the paralysed side

info.o: Body and cornu majus of the hyoid
info.i: Side of the tongue
info.f: Depresses and retracts the tongue

info.o: Skin and fascia of the upper chest (over pectoralis major and deltoid)
info.i: Lower border of the mandible, skin of the lower face and angulus oris
info.f: Tenses the skin of the neck, pulls the corner of the mouth down

info.o: Caput sternale: manubrium sterni · caput claviculare: medial third of the clavicle
info.i: Processus mastoideus and lateral linea nuchalis superior
info.f: One side: tilts the head to the same side and turns the face to the opposite side · both: extend the head, help inspiration. Shortened → torticollis

info.o: Venter posterior: incisura mastoidea · venter anterior: fossa digastrica of the mandible
info.i: Intermediate tendon, held to the hyoid by a fibrous loop
info.n: Venter anterior: n. mylohyoideus (V3) · venter posterior: n. facialis (VII)
info.f: Elevates the hyoid, opens the mouth (depresses the mandible)

info.i: Body of the hyoid (splits around the digastric tendon)
info.f: Elevates and pulls the hyoid backwards (swallowing)

info.i: Median raphe and body of the hyoid
info.f: Forms the floor of the mouth, elevates hyoid and tongue, opens the mouth

info.i: Body of the hyoid
info.n: C1 fibres travelling with the n. hypoglossus
info.f: Pulls the hyoid forward and up, opens the mouth

info.o: Back of the manubrium and medial clavicle
info.i: Body of the hyoid
info.f: Depresses the hyoid

info.o: Back of the manubrium (below sternohyoid) and 1st costal cartilage
info.i: Linea obliqua of the thyroid cartilage
info.f: Depresses the larynx

info.o: Linea obliqua of the thyroid cartilage
info.i: Body and cornu majus of the hyoid
info.n: C1 fibres travelling with the n. hypoglossus
info.f: Depresses the hyoid or elevates the larynx

info.o: Venter inferior: upper border of the scapula near the incisura scapulae
info.i: Venter superior: body of the hyoid (intermediate tendon tied to the clavicle)
info.f: Depresses the hyoid, tenses the fascia around the carotid sheath

info.i: Tuberculum musculi scaleni anterioris of the 1st rib
info.f: Elevates the 1st rib, bends the neck to the side. A. subclavia and plexus brachialis pass behind it through the scalene gap; V. subclavia passes in front

info.i: 1st rib, behind the sulcus arteriae subclaviae
info.f: Elevates the 1st rib, bends the neck to the side; back wall of the scalene gap

info.i: Outer surface of the 2nd rib
info.f: Elevates the 2nd rib, bends the neck to the side

info.i: Bodies and anterior tubercles C1–C6 (tuberculum anterius atlantis)
info.f: Flexes the cervical spine

info.i: Pars basilaris of the occipital bone
info.f: Flexes the head and upper neck

info.i: Pars basilaris of the occipital bone, in front of the foramen magnum
info.f: Flexes the head at the atlanto-occipital joint

info.i: Processus jugularis of the occipital bone
info.f: Bends the head to the side

info.o: Linea nuchalis superior, protuberantia occipitalis externa, lig. nuchae, processus spinosi C7–T12
info.i: Lateral third of the clavicle, acromion, spina scapulae
info.f: Pars descendens elevates, pars transversa retracts, pars ascendens depresses the scapula; together they rotate it upwards (arm above 90°). Lesion of XI → shoulder hangs down

info.o: Processus spinosi T7–L5, fascia thoracolumbalis, crista iliaca, ribs 10–12
info.i: Crista tuberculi minoris humeri
info.f: Adducts, extends and internally rotates the arm (climbing, "hand in back pocket")

info.i: Angulus superior and upper margo medialis of the scapula
info.f: Elevates the scapula and rotates it downwards

info.i: Margo medialis scapulae, below the spine
info.f: Retracts and elevates the scapula, fixes it to the thorax

info.i: Margo medialis scapulae, at the root of the spine
info.f: Retracts and elevates the scapula

info.i: Ribs 2–5, lateral to their angles
info.f: Elevates the ribs (inspiration)

info.i: Lower borders of ribs 9–12
info.f: Pulls the lower ribs down

info.i: Processus mastoideus, lateral linea nuchalis superior
info.f: Both sides: extend the head · one side: turns and bends the head to the same side

info.i: Tubercula posteriora C1–C3
info.f: Extends the neck, turns it to the same side

info.i: Angles of ribs 5–12
info.f: Extends the spine, bends it to the same side (lateral tract of the erector spinae)

info.i: Angles of ribs 1–6 and processus transversus C7
info.f: Extends the thoracic spine, bends it to the same side

info.i: Tubercula posteriora C4–C6
info.f: Extends the neck, bends it to the same side

info.o: Sacrum, processus spinosi of the lumbar vertebrae, lower thoracic transverse processes
info.i: Processus costales/transversi of lumbar and thoracic vertebrae, ribs 2–12
info.f: Extends the spine, bends it to the same side

info.i: Tubercula posteriora C2–C5
info.f: Extends the neck, bends it to the same side

info.o: Processus transversi T1–T3 and articular processes C4–C7
info.i: Processus mastoideus
info.f: Extends the head, turns and bends it to the same side

info.i: Processus spinosi T2–T8
info.f: Extends the thoracic spine (medial tract)

info.i: Processus spinosi C2–C4
info.f: Extends the neck

info.i: Occipital bone near the protuberantia occipitalis externa
info.f: Extends the head

info.i: Processus spinosi C6–T4 (spans 5–6 segments)
info.f: Extends the spine and turns it to the opposite side

info.i: Processus spinosi C2–C5
info.f: Extends the neck and turns it to the opposite side

info.o: Sacrum, mamillary processes (lumbar), transverse processes (thoracic), articular processes C4–C7
info.i: Processus spinosi 2–4 segments higher, up to C2
info.f: Stabilises the vertebrae, extends and turns the spine to the opposite side

info.i: Lamina and base of the spinous process 1–2 vertebrae higher
info.f: Turn the spine to the opposite side; proprioception

info.i: Processus spinosus of the vertebra above
info.f: Extend the spine (mainly cervical and lumbar)

parts: Dorsal parts of lateral intertransversarii lumborum muscles
Ventral parts of lateral intertransversarii lumborum muscles

info.o: Processus costalis of one lumbar vertebra
info.i: Processus costalis of the vertebra above
info.f: Bend the lumbar spine to the side

info.i: Next lower rib (breves) or the second rib below (longi)
info.f: Elevate the ribs, bend and turn the spine

info.i: Middle part of the linea nuchalis inferior
info.f: Extends the head and turns it to the same side

info.i: Medial part of the linea nuchalis inferior
info.f: Extends the head

info.i: Processus transversus atlantis
info.f: Turns atlas and head to the same side

info.i: Lateral part of the linea nuchalis inferior
info.f: Extends the head and bends it to the same side

parts: Clavicular head of pectoralis major muscle
Sternocostal head of pectoralis major muscle

info.o: Pars clavicularis: medial half of the clavicle · pars sternocostalis: sternum and costal cartilages 1–6 · pars abdominalis: rectus sheath
info.i: Crista tuberculi majoris humeri
info.f: Adducts and internally rotates the arm, clavicular part flexes it; accessory inspiratory muscle

info.i: Processus coracoideus
info.f: Pulls the scapula forward and down; accessory inspiratory muscle

info.i: Lower surface of the lateral clavicle
info.f: Stabilises the sternoclavicular joint, pulls the clavicle down

info.i: Margo medialis scapulae (costal side), angulus superior and inferior
info.f: Pulls the scapula forward, rotates it upwards (arm above 90°), holds it against the thorax. Lesion → scapula alata

info.o: Lower border of the rib above
info.i: Upper border of the rib below (fibres run down and forward – "hands in pockets")
info.f: Elevate the ribs – inspiration

info.o: Upper border of the rib below
info.i: Lower border of the rib above (fibres run down and backward)
info.f: Depress the ribs – expiration (parasternal part helps inspiration)

info.o: Upper border of the rib below
info.i: Lower border of the rib above (deepest layer)
info.f: Like the internal intercostals; the intercostal vein, artery and nerve (VAN) run between interni and intimi

info.o: Back of the lower sternum and processus xiphoideus
info.i: Costal cartilages 2–6
info.f: Pulls the costal cartilages down – expiration

info.o: Pars sternalis: processus xiphoideus · pars costalis: costal cartilages 7–12 · pars lumbalis: crura on L1–L3 and ligg. arcuata
info.i: Centrum tendineum
info.n: N. phrenicus (C3–C5) – "C3, 4, 5 keeps the diaphragm alive"
info.f: Main inspiratory muscle. Openings: V. cava T8, oesophagus T10, aorta T12

info.i: Costal cartilages 5–7 and processus xiphoideus
info.f: Flexes the trunk, abdominal press; tendinous intersections make the "six-pack"

info.i: Labium externum of the crista iliaca, lig. inguinale, aponeurosis to the linea alba
info.n: Nn. intercostales T5–T11, n. subcostalis, n. iliohypogastricus
info.f: One side: turns the trunk to the opposite side, bends it to the same side · both: flex the trunk, abdominal press

info.o: Fascia thoracolumbalis, linea intermedia of the crista iliaca, lateral lig. inguinale
info.i: Lower borders of ribs 10–12, aponeurosis to the linea alba; gives the M. cremaster
info.n: Nn. intercostales T8–T11, n. subcostalis, nn. iliohypogastricus and ilioinguinalis
info.f: One side: turns the trunk to the same side · both: flex the trunk, abdominal press

info.o: Inner surface of costal cartilages 7–12, fascia thoracolumbalis, labium internum of the crista iliaca, lateral lig. inguinale
info.i: Aponeurosis to the linea alba
info.n: Nn. intercostales T7–T11, n. subcostalis, nn. iliohypogastricus and ilioinguinalis
info.f: Abdominal press, narrows the waist like a belt

info.o: Ramus superior ossis pubis, in front of rectus abdominis
info.i: Linea alba
info.f: Tenses the linea alba (often absent)

info.o: Labium internum of the crista iliaca, lig. iliolumbale
info.i: 12th rib and processus costales L1–L4
info.n: N. subcostalis (T12) and rr. anteriores L1–L4
info.f: Bends the trunk to the side, holds the 12th rib down during inspiration

info.o: Bodies and discs T12–L4, processus costales L1–L5
info.i: Trochanter minor (together with iliacus as M. iliopsoas)
info.n: Rr. musculares of the plexus lumbalis (L1–L3)
info.f: Strongest hip flexor, also external rotation; bends the lumbar spine
